name: Sun Hung Kai & Co. Limited
summary: Sun Hung Kai & Co. Limited operates in the alternative investment and wealth management businesses in Hong Kong and the People's Republic of China. The company operates through Consumer Finance, Mortgage Loans, Investment Management, Alternative Solutions, and Group Management and Support segments. It offers unsecured and secured loans to individuals and small businesses through branches and online platforms; and first mortgage and second mortgage loans to property owners, as well as customized financing solutions to property investors.
